terminology_audit.source_grounding_versus_truth: Source maps bind IR constituents to source evidence and are not proof of a correct interpretation. Retrieval is not a truth criterion.
terminology_audit.vector_versus_text: Numerical reconstruction is embedding reconstruction (eq:emb, eq:rec). Symbolic/text cycles use eq:cycle. Decode returning a numeric vector is not a trained free-text decoder.
